title: Add +9179056555971 to backend admin OTP allowlist

requirements.text: Update the backend admin OTP authorization allowlist to include the mobile number "+9179056555971" as an authorized admin identifier so that calling `requestAdminOtp` and `verifyAdminOtp` with this identifier does not trigger any "not authorized" trap.

quotes: Add mobile number "+9179056555971" to admin authorized list in backend. Build now.

acceptanceCriteria: In `backend/main.mo`, the admin identifier allowlist contains the exact string "+9179056555971".
Calling `requestAdminOtp("+9179056555971")` succeeds (returns the OTP message) rather than trapping with a not-authorized error.
Calling `verifyAdminOtp("+9179056555971", <correct otp>, <clientIp>, <userAgent>)` does not fail due to allowlist rejection (it may still fail for other reasons like wrong OTP).

constraints: Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister (all logic in `backend/main.mo`).
nonGoals: Do not redesign the admin OTP flow (e.g., switching fully from email identifiers to phone-only identifiers) beyond adding this number to the existing backend allowlist.
No frontend changes are required unless the build fails without them.
